h1: Sheng Ji Price & Cost: Momentum Breakthrough Plan vs Lifetime Momentum Plan
heroSub: Prices are quoted in RMB and confirmed in writing before payment; Mr. Liang Dongrong handles enquiries and coordination

items.h3: Momentum Breakthrough Plan (Service Term: 5 Years): RMB 72,000
items.content: Total fee: RMB 72,000. Deposit: RMB 10,000; balance: RMB 62,000. The stated arrangement uses a shared plot and does not require travel to Taiwan. Confirm materials, courier or customs rules, delivery and any upgrade difference in writing before payment.

items.h3: Lifetime Momentum Plan: RMB 500,000 (Exclusive Plot Arrangement)
items.content: Total fee: RMB 500,000. The stated arrangement requires personal attendance in Taiwan and assigns an exclusive plot. The verifiable differences are price, term, attendance, plot-use arrangement and deliverables; exclusivity does not prove a stronger or longer-lasting effect. Confirm the itinerary and written scope before payment.

items.h3: Upgrading from the Momentum Breakthrough Plan to the Lifetime Momentum Plan
items.content: After completing the Momentum Breakthrough Plan (5-year service term), you can upgrade to the Lifetime Momentum Plan at any time by paying the difference of RMB 428,000. A new exclusive plot will be selected, and you will attend the full Lifetime Momentum Plan ceremony in Taiwan.

sections.h2: What Is Included in the RMB 72,000 Fee

items.h3: Full 2-Day Ceremony Conducted by Master Lin Jia-Hua
items.content: Master Lin Jia-Hua (Taoist name: Lin Yi Chan), ordained by the 64th Zhang Tianshi in 2007, personally conducts the complete Sheng Ji ceremony: Day 1 rituals at the studio including disaster-dispelling, wealth-replenishment and empowerment rites; Day 2 at the dragon vein site including the core box-interment ceremony.

items.h3: Full HD Video Recording of the Entire Ceremony
items.content: The agreed ceremony portions are recorded and delivered after completion. Video can help check which steps were recorded, but it cannot by itself prove practitioner credentials, land rights, uninterrupted performance or outcomes. Confirm the recording scope and privacy terms in writing.

items.h3: 3 Items Mailed Back to You After Completion
items.content: The stated return items are: (1) the garment used during the ceremony; (2) a pure-silver ingot presented as a ceremonial item; and (3) the agreed video recording. These items document or commemorate parts of the service and do not prove wealth, health or fortune outcomes.

items.h3: Step 1: Add WeChat NSDG521 and Confirm Your Booking
items.content: Contact Mr. Liang Dongrong via WeChat NSDG521 for the written package scope and current quote. Do not send sensitive personal data until the recipient, purpose, retention and handling terms have been confirmed.

items.h3: Step 2: Pay RMB 10,000 Deposit to Begin the Process
items.content: Once you confirm your booking, pay the deposit of RMB 10,000. The agent then mails you the specialised collection kit with full preparation instructions.
